verdicts.evidence: All three body paragraphs, from "THE RIVER FERRY RUNS…" to "…AT EACH LANDING.", are set entirely in capitals, under the mixed-case heading "Before you board".

The text says "every forty minutes between early morning and late evening" and "in winter the timetable thins to one boat each hour" with no times or dates, and it points readers to printed timetables "in the shelter at each landing".
